# TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR ACTIVITY
```{r}
TF_analysis <- RRS_df_median_2wk %>%
    dplyr::select(-X) %>%
    left_join(TF_data_EDWK2M6, by = "PID") 

# TF columns
tf_cols <- TF_analysis %>%
  dplyr::select(-PID, -RRS, -Group, -RRS_median_group, -Timepoint, -INVENTORY.CODE) %>%
  names()

# keep only Low/High RRS and needed timepoints
TF_analysis_sub <- TF_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    RRS_median_group %in% c("Low_RRS", "High_RRS"))

# long format
TF_long <- TF_analysis_sub %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group, Timepoint, all_of(tf_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(tf_cols),
    names_to = "TF",
    values_to = "TF_activity")

# wide format so interval changes can be calculated
TF_wide <- TF_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = TF_activity)

```

## Within class
```{r}
TF_interval_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(intervals)),
  function(i) {
    comp  <- intervals$Comparison[i]
    time1 <- intervals$time1[i]
    time2 <- intervals$time2[i]

    TF_wide %>%
      dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group, TF) %>%
      group_modify(~ run_paired_interval_test(.x, time1, time2)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        Comparison = comp,
        .before = 1)}) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group, Comparison) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(`P Value`, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RRS_median_group = factor(RRS_median_group, levels = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS")))

colnames(TF_interval_results)

TF_interval_results <- TF_interval_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Comparison, RRS_median_group, TF, FDR, `P Value`, `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)`, `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)`,`Avg Δ (M6 − ED)`, `T Stat`, `SE`, `95% CI`, `Avg ED`, `Avg WK2`, `Avg M6` ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`RRS Group` = RRS_median_group)

# EXPORT ------------------------------------------------------------
wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center")

add_sheet_with_data <- function(wb, sheet_name, data) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, data)

  addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, header_style,
           rows = 1, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)

  if(nrow(data) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, body_style,
             rows = 2:(nrow(data) + 1), cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)
  }

  setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = "auto")
}

sheet_order <- expand_grid(
  `RRS Group` = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),
  Comparison = c("ED_vs_WK2", "WK2_vs_M6", "ED_vs_M6"))


for(i in seq_len(nrow(sheet_order))) {

  group_i <- sheet_order$`RRS Group`[i]
  comp_i  <- sheet_order$Comparison[i]

  sheet_data <- TF_interval_results %>%
    filter(as.character(`RRS Group`) == group_i, Comparison == comp_i) %>%
    arrange(`P Value`)
  
  sheet_name <- paste(group_i, comp_i, sep = "_")
  add_sheet_with_data(wb, sheet_name, sheet_data)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "2WK Analyses/TF Activity/Within Group Longitudinal Tests/EDWK2M6_TF_within_class_results.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)


TF_interval_results_export <- TF_interval_results %>%
  dplyr::rename(Interval = Comparison) %>%
    mutate(
  Interval = case_when(
    Interval == "ED_vs_WK2" ~ "ED vs WK2",
    Interval == "WK2_vs_M6" ~ "WK2 vs 6M",
    Interval == "ED_vs_M6" ~ "ED vs 6M",
    TRUE ~ as.character(Interval)
  ), 
    `RRS Group` = case_when(
    `RRS Group` == "High_RRS" ~ "High RRS",
    `RRS Group` == "Low_RRS" ~ "Low RRS",
    TRUE ~ as.character(`RRS Group`)
  ),
   Direction = case_when(
      Interval == "ED vs WK2" & `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)` > 0 ~ "Higher at WK2",
      Interval == "ED vs WK2" & `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)` < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
      Interval == "WK2 vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)` > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
      Interval == "WK2 vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)` < 0 ~ "Higher at WK2",
      Interval == "ED vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − ED)` > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
      Interval == "ED vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − ED)` < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(Interval = factor(Interval, levels = c("ED vs WK2", "WK2 vs 6M", "ED vs 6M"))) %>%

  arrange(Interval, `RRS Group`, `P Value`)



write.csv(TF_interval_results_export, "2WK Analyses/TF Activity/Within Group Longitudinal Tests/EDWK2M6_TF_within_results_class.csv")
```

### Overlap of Significant TFs
```{r}

TF_results_EDWK2 <- TF_interval_results %>%
  filter(Comparison == "ED_vs_WK2") %>%
  arrange(RRS_median_group, p.value, abs(mean_change))

TF_results_WK2M6 <- TF_interval_results %>%
  filter(Comparison == "WK2_vs_M6") %>%
  arrange(RRS_median_group, p.value, abs(mean_change))

TF_results_EDM6 <- TF_interval_results %>%
  filter(Comparison == "ED_vs_M6") %>%
  arrange(p.value, abs(mean_change))


# significant TF names in each comparison
sig_ED2WK <- TF_results_EDWK2 %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  distinct(TF) %>%
  pull(TF)

sig_EDM6 <- TF_results_EDM6 %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  distinct(TF) %>%
  pull(TF)

# TF sets
TFs_ED2WK_only <- setdiff(sig_ED2WK, sig_EDM6)
TFs_EDM6_only  <- setdiff(sig_EDM6, sig_ED2WK)
TFs_shared  <- intersect(sig_ED2WK, sig_EDM6)

# helper function to annotate one TF set with all stats from both comparisons
make_annot_table <- function(tf_vec) {
  
  ed2wk_annot <- TF_results_EDWK2 %>%
    filter(TF %in% tf_vec) %>%
    dplyr::select(TF, RRS_median_group, n, mean_time1, mean_time2, mean_change, statistic, p.value, FDR) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = RRS_median_group, 
                values_from = c(n, mean_time1, mean_time2, mean_change, statistic, p.value, FDR)) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("ED2WK_", .x), -TF)
  
  edm6_annot <- TF_results_EDM6 %>%
    filter(TF %in% tf_vec) %>%
    dplyr::select(TF, RRS_median_group, n, mean_time1, mean_time2, mean_change, statistic, p.value, FDR) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = RRS_median_group,
                values_from = c(n, mean_time1, mean_time2, mean_change, statistic, p.value, FDR)) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("EDM6_", .x), -TF)
  
  full_join(ed2wk_annot, edm6_annot, by = "TF")
}

# annotated tables
ED2WK_only_annot <- make_annot_table(TFs_ED2WK_only) %>%
  dplyr::select(TF, ED2WK_mean_time1_High_RRS, ED2WK_mean_time1_Low_RRS, ED2WK_mean_time2_High_RRS, ED2WK_mean_time2_Low_RRS,
         ED2WK_mean_change_High_RRS, ED2WK_mean_change_Low_RRS, ED2WK_p.value_High_RRS, ED2WK_p.value_Low_RRS,
         ED2WK_FDR_High_RRS, ED2WK_FDR_Low_RRS) %>%
  dplyr::rename(High_ED_Mean = ED2WK_mean_time1_High_RRS, 
                Low_ED_Mean = ED2WK_mean_time1_Low_RRS, 
                High_WK2_Mean = ED2WK_mean_time2_High_RRS, 
                Low_WK2_Mean = ED2WK_mean_time2_Low_RRS, 
                High_Change = ED2WK_mean_change_High_RRS, 
                Low_Change = ED2WK_mean_change_Low_RRS, 
                High_pvalue = ED2WK_p.value_High_RRS, 
                Low_pvalue = ED2WK_p.value_Low_RRS, 
                High_FDR = ED2WK_FDR_High_RRS, 
                Low_FDR = ED2WK_FDR_Low_RRS) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(High_Change)))



EDM6_only_annot <- make_annot_table(TFs_EDM6_only) %>%

                EDM6_p.value_High_RRS, EDM6_p.value_Low_RRS, EDM6_FDR_High_RRS, EDM6_FDR_Low_RRS) %>%

    High_M6_Mean = EDM6_mean_time2_High_RRS,

    High_Change = EDM6_mean_change_High_RRS,
    Low_Change = EDM6_mean_change_Low_RRS,

    Low_pvalue = EDM6_p.value_Low_RRS,
    High_FDR = EDM6_FDR_High_RRS,
    Low_FDR = EDM6_FDR_Low_RRS) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(High_Change)))


shared_annot <- make_annot_table(TFs_shared) %>%
  dplyr::select(TF,
    ED2WK_mean_time1_High_RRS, ED2WK_mean_time1_Low_RRS,
    ED2WK_mean_time2_High_RRS, ED2WK_mean_time2_Low_RRS,

    ED2WK_mean_change_High_RRS, ED2WK_mean_change_Low_RRS,

# create ONE workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# add each table as a tab
addWorksheet(wb, "ED2WK_only")
```

## Between Class 
```{r}
TF_delta <- TF_wide %>%
  mutate(
    delta_ED_WK2 = WK2 - ED,
    delta_WK2_M6 = M6 - WK2, 
    delta_ED_M6 = M6 - ED)

TF_delta_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  unique(TF_delta$TF),
  function(tf) {

    df_ct <- TF_delta %>% filter(TF == tf)

    bind_rows(
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_ED_WK2") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "ED_vs_WK2"),
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_WK2_M6") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "WK2_vs_M6"), 
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_ED_M6") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "ED_vs_M6")) %>%
      mutate(TF = tf, .before = 1)
  }) %>%
  group_by(Comparison) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(`P Value`, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

TF_between_class <- TF_delta_results %>%
  arrange((FDR))


TF_between_sheets <- list(
  ED_vs_WK2 = TF_between_class %>%
    filter(Comparison == "ED_vs_WK2") %>%
    arrange(FDR),
  WK2_vs_M6 = TF_between_class %>%
    filter(Comparison == "WK2_vs_M6") %>%
    arrange(FDR),
  ED_vs_M6 = TF_between_class %>%
    filter(Comparison == "ED_vs_M6") %>%
    arrange(FDR))

wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center")

add_sheet_with_data <- function(wb, sheet_name, data) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, data)

  addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, header_style,
           rows = 1, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)

  if(nrow(data) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, body_style,
             rows = 2:(nrow(data) + 1), cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)
  }

  setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = "auto")
}

purrr::iwalk(
  TF_between_sheets,
  ~ add_sheet_with_data(wb, sheet_name = .y, data = .x))

saveWorkbook(wb, "2WK Analyses/TF Activity/Between Group Change Score Tests/EDWK2M6_TF_between_class_results.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

```

## Figure 6d
```{r}
selected_tfs <- c("TBX21","HIF1A","SPIB","IRF4","BACH1","MEF2C","MAF","CEBPA","MBD1","SPI1","NFKB1","RELA")
selected_tfs <- c("SPI1","NFKB1","JUN","RELA","ATF3","ETS1","ESRRA","GATA2","KLF1","TBX21","MAF","TCF7")

plot_df <- TF_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    RRS_median_group %in% c("Low_RRS", "High_RRS"),
    Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group, Timepoint, all_of(selected_tfs)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(selected_tfs),
    names_to = "TF",
    values_to = "TF_activity") %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("ED", "WK2", "M6")),
    TF = factor(TF, levels = selected_tfs),
    RRS_median_group = factor(
      RRS_median_group,
      levels = c("Low_RRS", "High_RRS"),
      labels = c("Low RRS", "High RRS"))) %>%
  group_by(RRS_median_group, Timepoint, TF) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_TF_activity = mean(TF_activity, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(TF_activity, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(TF_activity))),
    .groups = "drop")

tf_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = Timepoint, y = mean_TF_activity, group = RRS_median_group, color = RRS_median_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_TF_activity - se, ymax = mean_TF_activity + se), width = 0.08, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ TF, scales = "free_y", ncol = 6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "VIPER-inferred TF Activity", color = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = function(x) {
      r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      seq(r[1] + 0.06 * diff(r), r[2] - 0.06 * diff(r), length.out = 3)
    },
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low RRS" = "firebrick4", "High RRS" = "cyan3")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 2)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, margin = margin(r = 1)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"), 
      legend.margin = margin(t = -8),
  legend.box.margin = margin(t = -8),
  plot.margin = margin(t=15, b = 15))+
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.8, size = 5)))

tf_plot
```

## Figure 6d v2 
```{r}
selected_tfs <- c("TBX21","HIF1A","SPIB","IRF4","BACH1","MEF2C",
```
